scheme_name: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
other_conditions: Student must be a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central Government, State Government, Municipalities or recognized by the Department of Education
Parents/guardians must not be income taxpayers
Student must not be receiving any other scholarship or allowance for study from central, state or public sources
Student must not have failed in the lower class in the last session
If the student fails any year’s examination, the scholarship stops and the student must re‑apply for a new scholarship after passing
Student must not be living in a hostel (i.e., must be a non‑hosteller)
benefits_summary: ST boy students receive Rs. 75 per month and ST girl students receive Rs. 125 per month.
